jobs.title: Real Estate Business Developer
jobs.description: Decathlon Philippines is committed to a strategic, multi-year expansion initiative to better serve our customers across the region! To accompany this fast development, we are looking for a Real Estate Business Developer to develop, execute and manage business development projects leading to a profitable and sustainable growth for Decathlon within a dedicated zone/region. Key Responsibilities 1. Develop Local Expansion Strategy Define the vision and strategy for Decathlon's development (including stores and other formats) within the territory to increase market share. This includes: Analyzing market data (traffic, sales performance, competition, etc.). Designing the multi-channel network and planning the implementation of new solutions (e.g., shops, lockers, digital points), ensuring alignment with the Country Project. 2. Lead Project Development & Execution Manage the full lifecycle of real estate projects, including new openings and relocations: Source, negotiate, and secure sites (purchases/leases). Execute projects: Prepare studies, validate technical/financial details, secure permits, coordinate legal aspects, and control the budget. Manage local relationships with administrative/political bodies, and proactively advise on and execute physical partnerships and new business initiatives. 3. Manage Real Estate Portfolio Oversee the optimization and performance of the existing real estate assets: Track the financial performance (revenue/costs vs. budget) during a project's first year. Identify and execute store optimization opportunities (e.g., downsizing, enlarging, efficiency improvements, or green building investments). Execute land commercialization actions (sales or commercialization of vacant premises), following Asset Manager guidelines. jobs.title: Systems Application Engineer: 1 Year Contract
jobs.description: You'll make a difference by: Providing Level 2 technical support for mission-critical applications , troubleshooting and resolving complex system issues during the maintenance and support phase in collaboration with internal technical teams and customers. Testing and validating system updates , supporting pre- and post-release testing of application, software, and firmware updates to ensure stability and performance. Investigating and resolving incidents and defects , conducting root cause analysis and implementing fixes to minimize operational disruption. Communicating technical findings and progress clearly to customers , ensuring transparency on issue status, resolution timelines, and corrective actions. Monitoring system health and performance , identifying risks proactively and supporting customers in maintaining system reliability. Assessing and coordinating support ticket escalation , prioritizing and collaborating with internal teams to resolve issues based on business impact. Your defining qualities: Strong foundation in IT systems and infrastructure , with a degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Linux environments , including troubleshooting and system administration. 3–5 years of experience working with SQL and databases , with the ability to support data analysis and issue resolution. Familiarity with virtualization and infrastructure technologies , such as VMware, servers, storage, firewall, and networking environments. Experience working in a structured technical support or service environment , managing tickets within defined service levels. Customer-oriented and adaptable mindset , with strong communication skills and willingness to support after-hours or on-call when required.
